player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Tower of Hanoi ku {num_disks} disks.
Yin a lɔr disks ka tower A ku tower C.
Yin a lɔr disk, ket source tower ku target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Kɛɛlɛ yin a lɔr top disk a tower, ku yin a diɛɛl disk dɛɛr a disk tiɔp.
Kɛɛlɛ turn, submit move mɔɔk.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ci̱kɛ lɛy i̱ /ciɛ jɛn gua̱a̱th in took kɛ jɛ kiɛ min ca la̱t thi̱n.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Ji̱n ci jɛ ɣɔ̱n ɛn ɣöö bi disk woc rɛy tiecni ti thil ŋuäk.
invalid_move.same_tower: Ci̱ ji̱n ɛ go̱r i̱ bi disk naŋ kä töwɛrä mi̱ päär.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Ji̱n ci jɛ ɣɔ̱n ɛn ɣöö bi disk mi di̱i̱t la̱th kä min tɔt.

game_action.moved: Yin a lɔr disk {disk} ka {source} ku {target}.

outcome.win: Cää tɛth lɔaac! Ci̱ riɛk kä Tower of Hanoi luäŋ kɛ riali̱kä.
outcome.turn_limit: Kä cu pek in dë rietdɛ cop. Ci̱ ji̱n ɛ la̱th kɛ gua̱a̱ mi̱ cuŋ {pct}% kä di̱dhi̱ki̱ni̱ wi̱i̱ Duël-gɔ̱ɔ̱rä C.
